data.exact_reserve_text: Additional Run-off & RITC costs include the net impact of risk premium paid to the 2018 YOA, provision for 2020 run-off costs allocated to 2017 and prior YOA business, and favourable movement in 2016 & prior reserves.
data.standardized_narrative: The gross prior-year reserve movement for years before the two most recent underwriting years is very small, resulting in a net gross strengthening of approximately GBP 0.05m (c.0.04% of opening gross reserves). This net movement reflects offsetting development: a modest release on the oldest years (2015) largely offset by adverse development on 2016. The Syndicate cites specific large losses (notably on Energy and political-risk exposures and D&O) and reinsurance protections as the principal drivers, with some favourable development noted in 2016 & prior reserves in the narrative.
raw_causal_phrases: a number of large losses on the Energy and Political risk classes
Negative specific large loss experience arising from new losses on the political risk, D&O and energy classes
Stable experience in attritional and catastrophe reserves across all other classes of business
Higher than previously reserved premium receipts

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was not provided as a single explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line. PYD was therefore calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) (page 17) using the prescribed diagonal comparison method and excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2017 and 2018 as presented). The calculated gross PYD is very small (+GBP 0.054m). Note: the report documents reinsurance-to-close (RITC) activity and closure of the 2017 & prior YOA into 2018, which can distort development patterns; this may affect precision of PYD derived from the triangle. All monetary amounts reported elsewhere have been converted from the statement values (reported in GBP 000) into millions.
